description: This Java source file defines the AmqpConsumerActor class, which is an Akka actor responsible for consuming messages from an AMQP source, processing them, and forwarding them to a message processing actor within a messaging subsystem. It manages JMS consumer lifecycle, message handling, and rate limiting.

classes.name: AmqpConsumerActor
classes.description: An Akka actor managing AMQP message consumption via JMS, including lifecycle, message handling, rate limiting, consumer recreation, and forwarding messages to processing actors.

classes.name: CreateMessageConsumer
classes.description: A nested class representing a request to create a new JMS MessageConsumer for this actor.

classes.name: CreateMessageConsumerResponse
classes.description: A nested class representing the response containing a created MessageConsumer.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates the Akka Props configuration for instantiating an AmqpConsumerActor with specified connection and data.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor, including JMS message processing, status updates, and rate limiting.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the message consumer when the actor starts.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Performs cleanup, including destroying the message consumer, when the actor stops.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Receives a JMS Message and forwards it to self for processing.

methods.name: stopMessageConsumer
methods.description: Stops the current JMS message consumer.

methods.name: startMessageConsumer
methods.description: Starts the JMS message consumer.

methods.name: stopMessageConsumerDueToRateLimit
methods.description: Stops the consumer in response to rate limiting, logs the event.

methods.name: startMessageConsumerDueToRateLimit
methods.description: Restarts the consumer after rate limiting is lifted, logs the event.

methods.name: getMessageRateLimiter
methods.description: Returns the configured message rate limiter.

methods.name: initMessageConsumer
methods.description: Initializes and sets the JMS message listener.

methods.name: destroyMessageConsumer
methods.description: Closes and clears the current JMS message consumer.

methods.name: matchesOwnConsumer
methods.description: Checks if a ConsumerClosedStatusReport event matches the current consumer.

methods.name: handleConsumerClosed
methods.description: Handles an event where the consumer was closed, triggers recreation.

methods.name: messageConsumerCreated
methods.description: Handles successful creation of a new message consumer.

methods.name: messageConsumerFailed
methods.description: Handles failure in creating a new message consumer, escalates to parent.

methods.name: handleJmsMessage
methods.description: Processes a received JMS message, extracts headers and payload, and forwards message for processing.

methods.name: extractPayloadFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts payload bytes or text from a JMS message.

methods.name: extractHeadersMapFromJmsMessage
methods.description: Extracts message properties and application headers from a JMS message.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Returns the diagnostic logger for this actor.
